description:
Russell Brand sits down with theologian Jeremiah Johnston to discuss the nature of genuine faith after researchers confirmed the authenticity of the Shroud of Turin. Jeremiah breaks down why true Christian faith is never purely blind but is always rooted in historical evidence and reason, and why believing in the resurrection of Jesus because of proof is not a weakness but the foundation of genuine belief.
